entries.title: Jeremiah 28:2
segments: It is a common custom of false teachers to flatter men with the assurance of impunity in the practice of sin.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:6
segments: God's servants should manifest a tender and compassionate spirit, such as shall make it manifest to all that they take no delight in the messages of wrath which they deliver to the people in his name, and that it is the earnest desire of their hearts that by repentance and reformation the fulfilment of these threatenings may be averted.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:8
segments: Of war--of pestilence; the prediction of God's approaching judgments, with the view of bringing the people to repentance, was one of the signs of a true prophet; while the false prophets occupied themselves with quieting the consciences of the people in the practice of sin.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:9
segments:
. 
 
The awful destruction of the wicked will soon make manifest the folly of those who have flattered them with the hope of peace and safety in a course of iniquity.

entries.title: Jeremiah 28:13
segments:
For them; in their stead.  By encouraging the people in sin, Hananiah is making for them iron instead of wooden yokes; that is, aggravating the severity of their bondage. 
 
vv 13-17. 
 
God will not accommodate the course of his government to the wishes of corrupt rulers and false prophets who strengthen their hands in wickedness, but will destroy both together.
